title: Do Fairness Interventions Come at the Cost of Privacy: Evaluations for Binary Classifiers
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates fairness and privacy risks in binary classifiers using demographic attributes like gender and race.
findings: The paper does not analyze religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
